$comment: ACC v2 — the agentd exit-code contract, captured verbatim from crates/agentd/src/exit.rs at v1.3.1. `exit_codes` freezes the code→meaning table AND the pod_failure_intent mapping as a versioned API; any change to an existing code's meaning or intent bumps the major. agentctl refuses to compile podFailurePolicy rules for a major it does not understand. Unknown codes default to intent `retriable`.

codes.name: SUCCESS
codes.meaning: completed; a clean SIGTERM drain is also 0, never 143

codes.name: USAGE
codes.meaning: config or usage error; fails in ms, pre-LLM

codes.name: DEADLINE
codes.meaning: supervisor hard-kill backstop past the deadline

codes.name: SIGTERM_EXIT
codes.meaning: kernel-set 128+15: ungraceful SIGTERM (drain forced past budget)

intents.terminal: a retry never helps — compile to FailJob
intents.policy: default Count; honour the operator's --budget-exit-code remap when present
intents.infra: kernel-set kill; the fix is a resource/config change — never author a retry rule

budget_remap.note: only PARTIAL(3) and BUDGET(7) remap; every other code is returned unchanged. The remap applies only to the final process exit code; the run report keeps the canonical projection.
